intent: Thicken the upper, lower and outboard laptop walls inward by 2.8 mm each, replacing lost lining thickness with PETG.
invariants: Felt + RailWall remains 9 mm: laptop pose and main external rail surfaces stay fixed.
Felt + SideWall remains 9 mm: common outboard print plane, bracket width and lateral space after lining stay fixed.
Desk clamp, bolt holes, upper spacer cutout and clamp fit sample remain unchanged.
Keep nominal laptop angle 30 degrees and upper/lower capture lengths 75/85 mm.
implementation_when_freecad_is_available: Inspect and preserve the current document and any user edits before changing parameters.
Apply Felt=1.2 mm, RailWall=7.8 mm, SideWall=7.8 mm together, then recompute.
Describe Felt as the combined 1 mm felt plus 0.2 mm tape, including pad group labels.
Fix the build_holders.py parameter check: save and restore the actual Felt value, rather than hard-coding a return to 4 mm.
Refresh cosmetic edge links. Recalculate and verify the mouth tangent because the inner lower fillet moves with the thicker rail.
Verify all solids, lining clearances, full-width base blends, common print plane and unchanged mounting interface.
Update CAD, STL, STEP, lining cut sizes, previews and validation report.
Re-slice the full holder with the accepted gyroid settings and review supports again; do not label the old G-code as the updated design.
existing_files: FCStd, STL, STEP, PrusaSlicer projects and right-holder G-code now use 1.2 mm combined lining and 7.8 mm laptop walls. The desk-clamp sample is unchanged.
